Terms of Use.

A few ground rules for using our website, quiz, and contact service.

Last updated 30 October 2026

In these termsWhat these terms coverAcceptable useQuiz & inquiriesOwnership & your contentAvailability & responsibilityChanges & questions

What these terms cover

These terms concern use of the Hotwire Interactive website, operated by our independent studio based in Belgium. They do not replace a proposal or agreement for paid work.

Browsing the site, completing the quiz, or sending an inquiry does not place an order or create a contract for a website. Scope, pricing, payment, delivery, ownership of deliverables, support, and any cancellation rights must be addressed in a separate project agreement.

Acceptable use

You may browse the site, use the quiz, keep its recommendation, and contact us for legitimate purposes. Please do not:

  • Send spam, malware, unlawful content, or information you have no right to share.
  • Attempt unauthorised access, evade security or rate limits, or disrupt the website or its providers.
  • Impersonate someone or deliberately provide misleading contact information.
  • Copy or republish protected website material beyond what applicable law or a licence permits.

If you discover a security issue, contact contact@hotwireinteractive.co.uk without accessing other people’s information or disrupting the service.

Quiz & inquiries

The website-fit quiz provides a general planning suggestion based on ten answers. Package ranges and allowances are indicative budgets, not a quote, final technical specification, price cap, or promise of delivery. Scope, tax treatment, total payable, integrations, content, security, recurring costs, and dates need a written proposal.

You can keep or copy your visitor-facing description. Choosing “Discuss this website” or a design direction prepares an inquiry brief, which you can review or remove before sending the contact form. Fictional design demos are not client work or operating shops/studios; their basket and booking interactions create no orders, payments, or reservations.

The agreement page provides process information and a printable review draft, not an issued offer, invoice, or document to sign. Printing/preparing it does not form a contract or verify a signature/payment. Work requires a studio-issued signed agreement, independently verified cleared 50% deposit, and written kickoff confirmation. Actual payment and cancellation terms belong in the reviewed project agreement, subject to applicable rights.

Please use an email address where we can reach you and avoid passwords, payment details, or sensitive personal information. The form does not accept attachments. A successful form response means our mail server accepted the inquiry; it does not guarantee delivery to an inbox or a particular response time. If necessary, email us directly.

Our Privacy notice explains the handling of inquiry information. Our Cookies & Storage notice explains the site’s browser storage.

Ownership & your content

Website text, branding, code, and artwork may be protected by intellectual property rights. Rights remain with their respective owners. Third-party fonts, libraries, and other material remain subject to their own licences.

You retain your rights in material you send us. You allow us to handle that material as needed to assess and respond to your inquiry. Sending a message does not grant us a general right to publish your work or use it in marketing.

You are responsible for having the right to share information you submit. Ownership and permitted use of any commissioned deliverables will be covered by the relevant project agreement.

Availability & responsibility

We aim to keep this site useful and accurate, but information may change or contain mistakes. The website, quiz, or contact service may occasionally be unavailable for maintenance or technical reasons. Please check important project information with us before relying on it.

External links and third-party services are outside our control and have their own terms and privacy notices.

Nothing in these terms excludes liability that cannot lawfully be excluded, limits mandatory consumer rights, or overrides any protection that applicable law gives you. These website terms do not change an existing project contract.

Changes & questions

We may update these website terms as the site changes. The date above identifies this version. Changes do not retrospectively amend a separate project agreement.

For questions about these terms or use of this website, contact contact@hotwireinteractive.co.uk.
